32 function object(value) {

36 function clone(value) {

44 function canonical(value, ancestors = new Set()) {
45   if (value === null) return 'null';
46   if (typeof value === 'string' || typeof value === 'boolean') return JSON.stringify(value);
47   if (typeof value === 'number') {
48     demand(Number.isFinite(value), 'INVALID_DIGEST_VALUE', 'Digests require finite JSON numbers.');
49     return JSON.stringify(value);
50   }
51   demand(object(value) || Array.isArray(value), 'INVALID_DIGEST_VALUE',
52     'Digests require JSON values; undefined and executable values are not supported.');
53   demand(!ancestors.has(value), 'INVALID_DIGEST_VALUE', 'Digests cannot contain cycles.');
54   ancestors.add(value);
55   let result;
56   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
57     result = '[' + Array.from(value, item => canonical(item, ancestors)).join(',') + ']';
58   } else {
59     result = '{' + Object.keys(value).sort()
60       .map(key => JSON.stringify(key) + ':' + canonical(value[key], ancestors)).join(',') + '}';
61   }
62   ancestors.delete(value);
63   return result;
64 }

66 export function refinementDigest(value) {
67   return createHash('sha256').update(canonical(value)).digest('hex');
68 }

208 // Recompute through the DAG so reopening a foundation also blocks grandchildren.
209 // Operational phase is separate from the derived dependency readiness phase.
210 function refreshDependencies(state) {
211   const visiting = new Set();
212   const visited = new Set();
213   function visit(slice) {
214     demand(!visiting.has(slice.step_id), 'DEPENDENCY_CYCLE', 'Slice dependencies contain a cycle.');
215     if (visited.has(slice.step_id)) return;
216     visiting.add(slice.step_id);
217     for (const dependency of slice.depends_on) {
218       const foundation = getSlice(state, dependency.slice_id);
219       visit(foundation);
220       const previousState = dependency.state;
221       if (!hasClosedFoundation(state, dependency)) {
222         dependency.state = dependency.presentation_id === null ? 'waiting' : 'needs_reconciliation';
223       } else if (dependency.presentation_id === null) {
224         dependency.state = 'waiting';
225       } else {
226         const closed = getPresentation(foundation, foundation.closed_presentation);
227         const matches = dependency.presentation_id === closed.id &&
228           refinementDigest(dependency.accepted_revision_hashes) === refinementDigest(revisionHashes(closed));
229         dependency.state = matches
230           ? (dependency.state === 'rechecked' ? 'rechecked' : 'pinned')
231           : 'needs_reconciliation';
232       }
233       if (dependency.state === 'needs_reconciliation' && previousState !== 'needs_reconciliation') {
234         dependency.invalidated_candidate_digest = refinementDigest(slice.candidate);
235         dependency.invalidated_generation = state.generation;
236       }
237     }
238     const stale = slice.depends_on.some(dependency => dependency.state === 'needs_reconciliation');
239     const waiting = slice.depends_on.some(dependency => dependency.state === 'waiting');
240     if (stale || waiting) {
241       unclose(slice, state.generation, 'foundation_not_ready');
242       slice.phase = stale ? 'needs_reconciliation' : 'waiting_foundation';
243       supersedeRequests(state, slice, 'foundation_not_ready');
244     } else {
245       slice.phase = slice.work_phase;
246     }
247     visiting.delete(slice.step_id);
248     visited.add(slice.step_id);
249   }
250   for (const slice of Object.values(state.slices)) visit(slice);
251   refreshProducerHandoffs(state);
252   refreshPendingRequest(state);
253 }

255 function producerDependencyPins(dependencies) {
256   if (!Array.isArray(dependencies)) return dependencies;
257   return dependencies.map(dependency => object(dependency) ? {
258     slice_id: dependency.slice_id ?? null,
259     presentation_id: dependency.presentation_id ?? null,
260     accepted_revision_hashes: dependency.accepted_revision_hashes ?? null,
261   } : dependency).sort((a, b) => {
262     const aKey = object(a) && nonempty(a.slice_id) ? a.slice_id : refinementDigest(a);
263     const bKey = object(b) && nonempty(b.slice_id) ? b.slice_id : refinementDigest(b);
264     return aKey < bKey ? -1 : aKey > bKey ? 1 : 0;
265   });
266 }

268 function validateHandoffPresentedOutputs(handoff, slice, presentation, reconciliation) {
269   const declared = new Set(handoff.outputs.flatMap(output => typeof output === 'string' ? [output]
270     : [output.source_ref, output.path].filter(nonempty)));
271   const presentedRefs = new Set();
272   for (const member of presentation.members) {
273     const revision = slice.revisions[member.revision_id];
274     for (const reference of [member.source_ref, member.path, revision?.source_ref, revision?.path]) {
275       if (nonempty(reference)) presentedRefs.add(reference);
276     }
277   }
278   const mappings = reconciliation?.output_mappings === undefined ? [] : reconciliation.output_mappings;
279   demand(Array.isArray(mappings), 'INVALID_HANDOFF_OUTPUT_MAPPINGS',
280     'output_mappings must be an array of sourced mappings to selected presentation members.');
281   const mapped = new Set();
282   for (const mapping of mappings) {
283     demand(object(mapping) && nonempty(mapping.source_ref) && nonempty(mapping.product_id) &&
284       nonempty(mapping.revision_id) && nonempty(mapping.source) && nonempty(mapping.reason),
285     'INVALID_HANDOFF_OUTPUT_MAPPING',
286     'Each output mapping requires source_ref, product_id, revision_id, source and reason.');
287     demand(declared.has(mapping.source_ref) ||
288       (!handoff.inventory_complete && reconciliation.inventory_verified === true),
289     'HANDOFF_OUTPUT_MAPPING_UNDECLARED',
290     'Newly inspected references require an originally incomplete inventory and explicit inventory verification.');
291     demand(presentation.members.some(member =>
292       member.product_id === mapping.product_id && member.revision_id === mapping.revision_id),
293     'HANDOFF_OUTPUT_MAPPING_MEMBER_UNKNOWN',
294     'An output mapping must name an existing member of the selected presentation.');
295     demand(!mapped.has(mapping.source_ref), 'HANDOFF_OUTPUT_MAPPING_CONFLICT',
296       'Each source reference must have one explicit output mapping.');
297     mapped.add(mapping.source_ref);
298   }
299   demand(declared.size > 0 || (!handoff.inventory_complete && mappings.length > 0),
300     'HANDOFF_OUTPUT_INVENTORY_REQUIRED',
301     'Published resolution requires declared outputs, or verified inspected-output mappings for an originally incomplete inventory.');
302   for (const reference of declared) {

305   }

308 // A captured dispatch context is written once (cloned at the handoff) and only read after, so its
309 // field digests are kept with it; a slice's digests are taken once per refresh, not once per handoff.
310 // The fold refreshes after every event, so without this the read re-hashed every pending handoff's
311 // context on every event (the MBA record: 717 events, ~6 s a read).
312 const capturedDigests = new WeakMap();
313 
314 function capturedDigest(dispatch, field) {
315   let digests = capturedDigests.get(dispatch);
316   if (!digests) capturedDigests.set(dispatch, digests = new Map());
317   if (!digests.has(field)) {
318     digests.set(field, refinementDigest(field === 'depends_on' ? producerDependencyPins(dispatch[field]) : dispatch[field]));
319   }
320   return digests.get(field);
321 }
322 
323 function refreshProducerHandoffs(state) {
324   const fields = ['step_id', 'round', 'requirements', 'candidate', 'depends_on'];
325   const currentDigests = new Map();
326   const currentDigest = (slice, field) => {
327     let digests = currentDigests.get(slice);
328     if (!digests) currentDigests.set(slice, digests = new Map());
329     if (!digests.has(field)) {
330       digests.set(field, refinementDigest(field === 'depends_on' ? producerDependencyPins(slice[field]) : slice[field]));
331     }
332     return digests.get(field);
333   };
334   for (const handoff of Object.values(state.producer_handoffs)) {
335     if (handoff.status !== 'pending_steward_review') continue;
336     const slice = handoff.step_id === null ? null : getSlice(state, handoff.step_id);
337     const dispatch = handoff.dispatch_context;
338     const known = object(dispatch) && nonempty(dispatch.step_id) &&
339       Number.isInteger(dispatch.round) && dispatch.round >= 0 &&
340       object(dispatch.requirements) && object(dispatch.candidate) && Array.isArray(dispatch.depends_on) &&
341       dispatch.depends_on.every(dependency => object(dependency) && nonempty(dependency.slice_id) &&
342         Object.hasOwn(dependency, 'presentation_id') &&
343         (dependency.presentation_id === null || nonempty(dependency.presentation_id)) &&
344         object(dependency.accepted_revision_hashes)) &&
345       new Set(dispatch.depends_on.map(dependency => dependency.slice_id)).size === dispatch.depends_on.length;
346     const changed = [];
347     if (slice && object(dispatch)) {
348       for (const field of fields) {
349         if (Object.hasOwn(dispatch, field)) {
350           if (capturedDigest(dispatch, field) !== currentDigest(slice, field)) changed.push(field);
351         }
352       }
353     }
354     const reasons = [];
355     if (!slice) reasons.push('slice_unmapped');
356     if (!known) reasons.push('dispatch_context_unknown');
357     if (changed.length > 0) reasons.push('dispatch_context_changed');
358     if (!handoff.inventory_complete) reasons.push('output_inventory_incomplete');
359     if (handoff.terminal === null) reasons.push('terminal_observation_missing');
360     handoff.freshness = !slice || !known ? 'unknown' : changed.length > 0 ? 'stale' : 'current';
361     handoff.changed_context_fields = changed;
362     handoff.review_reasons = reasons;
363   }
364 }

366 function refreshPendingRequest(state) {
367   let oldest = null;
368   let oldestGeneration = Infinity;
369   for (const slice of Object.values(state.slices)) {
370     for (const request of slice.review_requests) {
371       if (request.status !== 'pending') continue;
372       const generation = getPresentation(slice, request.presentation_id).generation;
373       if (generation < oldestGeneration ||
374         (generation === oldestGeneration && (oldest === null || request.id < oldest.id))) {
375         oldest = request;
376         oldestGeneration = generation;
377       }
378     }
379   }
380   // Focus is derived from existing requests; it is not a second queue or store.
381   state.pending_request = oldest === null ? null : clone(oldest);
382 }

406 function recomputeRequirements(slice) {
407   // Feedback disposition concerns a proposed instruction, not its content polarity.
408   // Declining "include X" does not turn it into an active "exclude X" directive.
409   for (const requirement of Object.values(slice.requirements)) {
410     const feedback = slice.feedback.find(item => item.id === requirement.feedback_id);
411     requirement.status = feedback.disposition === 'incorporated' ? 'active'
412       : feedback.disposition === 'declined' ? 'rejected'
413       : feedback.disposition === 'parked' ? 'parked' : 'pending';
414     delete requirement.superseded_by;
415   }
416   for (const requirement of Object.values(slice.requirements)) {
417     if (requirement.status === 'active' && requirement.supersedes) {
418       const previous = slice.requirements[requirement.supersedes];
419       previous.status = 'superseded';
420       previous.superseded_by = requirement.id;
421     }
422   }
423 }

451 function applyOperation(state, operation, event) {
452   demand(object(operation), 'INVALID_OPERATION', 'refinement_update requires an operation object.');
453   demand((event.version === undefined || event.version === 1) &&

455   'UNSUPPORTED_VERSION', 'Only refinement_update version 1 is supported.');

458     'INVALID_EXPECTED_SEQ', 'expected_seq must be a nonnegative integer.');
459   demand(nonempty(operation.action), 'INVALID_ACTION', 'An action is required.');
460   state.generation += 1;
461   state.last_event_at = event.at ?? event.timestamp ?? event.ts ?? null;

463   if (operation.action === 'adopt') {
464     demand(!state.managed, 'ALREADY_ADOPTED', 'Managed refinement mode can only be adopted once.');
465     identifier(operation.campaign_id, 'campaign_id');
466     for (const name of ['PLAN.md', 'DELIVERABLES.md']) {
467       const document = operation.documents?.[name];
468       demand(object(document) && typeof document.exists === 'boolean' &&
469         typeof document.baseline === 'string', 'INVALID_ADOPTION_BASELINE',
470       'Adoption must record existence and an exact baseline string for ' + name + '.');

472     state.adoption = {
473       campaign_id: operation.campaign_id,
474       documents: clone(operation.documents),
475       elegance: elegance(operation.elegance, 'full'),
476       at: state.last_event_at,
477       generation: state.generation,
478     };
479     state.managed = true;
480     return state;

483   demand(state.managed, 'NOT_ADOPTED', 'Explicit adoption is required before refinement operations.');

485   if (operation.action === 'producer_handoff') {
486     const handoffId = identifier(operation.handoff_id, 'handoff_id');
487     demand(!Object.hasOwn(state.producer_handoffs, handoffId),
488       'HANDOFF_EXISTS', 'Producer handoff IDs are immutable; retry through ledger operation idempotency.');
489     demand(['job', 'conversation', 'terminal'].includes(operation.producer_kind),
490       'INVALID_PRODUCER_KIND', 'Producer kind must be job, conversation or terminal.');
491     demand(nonempty(operation.source_ref), 'HANDOFF_SOURCE_REQUIRED',
492       'A producer handoff requires an explicit source reference.');
493     demand(Array.isArray(operation.outputs) && operation.outputs.every(output =>
494       nonempty(output) || (object(output) && nonempty(output.source_ref))),
495     'INVALID_HANDOFF_OUTPUTS', 'Outputs must be explicit nonempty references or objects with source_ref.');
496     demand(typeof operation.inventory_complete === 'boolean', 'HANDOFF_INVENTORY_REQUIRED',
497       'A handoff must explicitly state whether its output inventory is complete.');
498     const stepId = operation.step_id ?? null;
499     if (stepId !== null) getSlice(state, stepId);
500     const dispatch = operation.dispatch_context ?? null;
501     demand(dispatch === null || object(dispatch), 'INVALID_DISPATCH_CONTEXT',

504     demand(terminal === null || nonempty(terminal) || object(terminal), 'INVALID_TERMINAL_OBSERVATION',
505       'terminal must preserve an explicit terminal observation or be null.');

507       handoff_id: handoffId, producer_kind: operation.producer_kind,
508       source_ref: operation.source_ref, step_id: stepId, outputs: clone(operation.outputs),
509       dispatch_context: dispatch === null ? null : clone(dispatch),
510       terminal: terminal === null ? null : clone(terminal),
511       inventory_complete: operation.inventory_complete,
512       status: 'pending_steward_review',
513       freshness: 'unknown', changed_context_fields: [], review_reasons: [],
514       operation_id: operation.operation_id, generation: state.generation, at: state.last_event_at,
515       resolution: null,

518     refreshPendingRequest(state);

945       const digest = refinementDigest(slice.candidate);
946       const invalidated = slice.depends_on.filter(item => item.state === 'needs_reconciliation');
947       const baselineDigests = previous ? [previous.candidate_digest]
948         : invalidated.map(item => item.invalidated_candidate_digest);
949       demand(Object.keys(slice.candidate).length > 0 && baselineDigests.length > 0 &&
950         baselineDigests.every(baseline => nonempty(baseline) && digest !== baseline),
951         'RECONCILIATION_REVISION_REQUIRED', 'Reconciliation requires a changed downstream candidate after its handback.');
952       demand(object(operation.evidence) && operation.evidence.outcome === 'pass' &&
953         nonempty(operation.evidence.source) && operation.evidence.candidate_digest === digest,
954       'RECONCILIATION_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED', 'Reconciliation must name the changed candidate digest and passing evidence.');
955       demand(Array.isArray(operation.depends_on) && operation.depends_on.length > 0,
956         'INVALID_DEPENDENCIES', 'Reconcile requires explicit dependency pins.');
957       const seen = new Set();
958       for (const requested of operation.depends_on) {
959         const dependency = slice.depends_on.find(item => item.slice_id === requested?.slice_id);
960         demand(dependency && !seen.has(dependency.slice_id), 'INVALID_DEPENDENCY',
961           'Reconcile can only update existing dependency edges, once each.');
962         seen.add(dependency.slice_id);
963         const foundation = state.slices[dependency.slice_id];
964         demand(requested.presentation_id === foundation.closed_presentation,
965           'FOUNDATION_PRESENTATION_NOT_CLOSED', 'The replacement pin must name the foundation current closed set.');
966         const presentation = getPresentation(foundation, requested.presentation_id);
967         dependency.presentation_id = presentation.id;
968         dependency.accepted_revision_hashes = revisionHashes(presentation);
969         dependency.state = 'rechecked';
970         delete dependency.invalidated_candidate_digest;
971         delete dependency.invalidated_generation;
972       }
973       slice.reconciliation_history.push({
974         round: slice.round, candidate_digest: digest, evidence: clone(operation.evidence),
975         pins: clone(operation.depends_on), generation: state.generation, at: state.last_event_at,
976       });
977       slice.work_phase = slice.round === 0 ? 'preparing' : 'revising';
978       break;
979     }
980     default:
981       fail('UNKNOWN_ACTION', 'Unsupported refinement action: ' + operation.action);
982   }
983   refreshDependencies(state);
984   return state;
985 }
986 
987 export function foldRefinements(events) {
988   demand(Array.isArray(events), 'INVALID_EVENTS', 'Roadmap events must be an array.');
989   const state = emptyState();
990   for (const event of events) {
991     if (event?.kind !== 'refinement_update') continue;
992     applyOperation(state, clone(event.operation), event);
993   }
994   return state;
995 }
996 
997 export function validateRefinementOperation(events, operation, context = {}) {
998   try {
999     const state = foldRefinements(events);
1000     applyOperation(state, clone(operation), {
1001       at: context.event_at ?? context.at ?? null,
1002     });
1003     return { ok: true, state };
1004   } catch (error) {
1005     return {
1006       ok: false,
1007       error: error.code ?? 'INVALID_OPERATION',
1008       detail: error.detail ?? error.message,
1009     };
1010   }
1011 }
